## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and result of this change. Link the issue when available.

## Validation

Record relevant behavior/boundary coverage and the result of `make check`. For packaged changes, record `make package`; preserve needed binaries in dist, then run `cargo clean`.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe configuration, schema or protocol changes, update user/developer docs and CHANGELOG as needed, and confirm examples contain synthetic data. Preserve third-party notices for dependency changes.
